'''Angu Drombb''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] in the employ of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. One of his mission was to terrorize the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] near [[New Meen]], on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], to gain control of the [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] trade.
